title: Sync scenario
description: A machine-readable worked example: a complete server log and the state every replica must reach. Consumed by tools/model.py and by the convergence tests of T006/T107/server. SYNC.md section 13.

covers.description: Spec conflict cases and ticket items this scenario demonstrates.

narrative.description: Human explanation, one step per line.

devices.description: Label -> device id. 'S' is the server.

log.description: The server's change log for this scenario in seq order, server-emitted ops included. Applying it in order to an empty replica (built-in seeds only) must give `expected`.

rejected.description: Ops a device pushed that the server must reject (never in the log), with the expected error code.

received_at.description: Server receive time used for the clock checks (SYNC.md 3.4). Default: wall(hlc) of the last log op.

order_free.description: true: ANY interleaving of the per-device op streams (each device's ops kept in log order; an op applied only once every row it references exists) must reach the same state under the convergence projection (SYNC.md section 11). false: only log order and real device orders are guaranteed.

expected.description: State after the whole log, in device representation (instants as epoch ms, arrays as JSON arrays).

rows.description: table -> list of partial rows. Each must match exactly one row: the row whose primary-key columns equal the given ones; every other listed column must be equal.

absent.description: table -> list of primary keys (objects) that must NOT exist.

replay_sets.description: card id -> review_log ids of its replay set, in replay order.
